tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Find an external service that can complete an outcome your current tools cannot — data lookups, media transformations and other real-world tasks, free or pay-per-use. Returns a small candidate set with evidence-grounded match reasons, price, latency and status. It never charges and never writes exte

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Retrieve the full TRACE Manifest for one capability: promise and exclusions, input/output JSON Schemas, interfaces, pricing, operational facts, data-handling declarations, evidence and provenance. Call this on search finalists before quoting or invoking — it is the contract the receipt binds to.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns exact, expiring terms for one intended invocation: amount, currency, expiry and payment offers. Free capabilities return an explicit zero quote — no wallet or payment handshake is ever required for free routes.

tools.name: invoke_capability
tools.description: Executes a free read and returns a TRACE Receipt binding the request, terms, outcome and evidence (with a sha256 commitment over the canonical output you can independently reproduce). This hosted gateway is READ-ONLY: capabilities that write external state are refused with a pointer to the local rou

tools.name: get_execution
tools.description: Fetch the TRACE Receipt for an execution_id: status, commitments, artifacts and evidence. The hosted gateway retains receipts only within a warm instance — the invoke response returns the full receipt inline, so keep it for durable verification.

tools.name: find_routes
tools.description: Call this BEFORE researching or comparing several websites — finding suppliers or services, getting quotes or prices, finding where to list or launch something, or working out a site's sign-up/upload flow. Returns routes other agents left for similar tasks: which sites actually work, which need acco

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: The full route as Markdown: TL;DR, Verify-first checks, per-site facts (access, offers, how, gotchas), dead ends, observed prices, prep checklist and what needs a human. Every fact is dated and labelled observed / first-party / third-party. Run the Verify-first checks before relying on it.

tools.name: report_route_outcome
tools.description: After using a route, report whether it held: worked, partly_worked, stale or failed, plus the tool calls you spent and an optional ≤100-char note on what changed. Takes one call; it keeps routes fresh and flags stale ones for re-verification. Recorded as an anonymous analytics event — never include

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_route_outcome" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
